 PM Modi to Launch Projects Worth ₹14,000 Crore in Gujarat 
 News On AIR | 
 October 29, 2026 9:42 PM 
 PM Modi to Launch Projects Worth ₹14,000 Crore in Gujarat
 Prime Minister Narendra Modi will be on a two-day visit to Gujarat, beginning tomorrow. Mr Modi will lay the foundation stone, inaugurate and dedicate to the nation various development projects worth over 14 thousand crore rupees in Banaskantha tomorrow.
 The Prime Minister will lay the foundation stone of Ahmedabad Metro Phase-2A (Airport Extension) and Phase-2B (GIFT City Extension). He will also release the 24th instalment under PM-KISAN, amounting to 19 thousand crore rupees.
 He will also visit the Embryo Transfer Technology-In Vitro Fertilisation Laboratory and the Bharat Bovine Breeding and Research Centre cattle farm in Banaskantha.
 The Centre will strengthen bovine breeding, genetic upgradation and advanced reproductive technologies, accelerating breed improvement by 10 to 20 times. Thereafter, the Prime Minister will travel to Ekta Nagar, Kevadia and inaugurate Bharat Parv 2026.
On Saturday, Prime Minister Modi will offer floral tributes at the Statue of Unity. Mr Modi will lay the foundation stone, inaugurate and dedicate to the nation various development projects worth over four hundred crore rupees in Ekta Nagar.
 The projects include a sewage and water treatment plant, facade lighting, the upgradation of Narmada Ghat, and the Rainforest, among others. The Prime Minister will also participate in the Rashtriya Ekta Diwas celebrations commemorating the 151st birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel.
